info.name: MTN Revenue Platform
info.description:
Comprehensive API collection for the MTN Revenue Platform.

Covers all currently implemented modules:
1. Identity & Authentication (register, login, me, validation and conflict checks)
2. Service Onboarding & API Keys (services CRUD, minting keys, whoami, key revocation)
3. Revenue Events (event ingest, idempotency deduplication, event queries, dashboard views, and summary aggregates)
4. Double-Entry Ledger & Posting Rules (chart of accounts, fractional posting rules, posting pending events, entries cursor paging, derived balances, and failure handling)
5. Adjustments & Refunds (immutable reversals, over-refund prevention, adjustments query, and refund posting)
6. Daily Aggregates & Metrics (rollups rebuild, daily metrics series and totals, health telemetry, and admin cross-service overview)

### How to run:
1. Start the server: in `packages/server`, run `npm run start:dev`
2. In Postman, click **Import** and select this file (`postman/revenue-platform.postman_collection.json`)
3. Click **Run collection** to run the entire suite automatically from top to bottom.
All tokens, service IDs, and API keys are captured and passed forward via collection variables automatically!
